distinct_type_rationale.why_a_5th_type: the 4 non-anchor welded TYPES are null-control (example.com) + retail-catalog (books.toscrape.com) + service-booking (acuityscheduling.com) + data-retrieval (ipinfo.io); the two anchors are MULTI-archetype API storefronts (metered_api + digital_good + subscription). api.replicate.com is the PURE, SINGLE-archetype metered_api compute/inference storefront — a structurally-distinct 5th type: no digital_good/subscription/data_retrieval bundled.
distinct_type_rationale.pillar_shape_vs_retail_at_same_overall: api.replicate.com 29.5 (access 100.0 / legibility 18.18 / transactability 0.0 / trust 33.33) has the SAME overall as books.toscrape.com 29.5 but a DISTINCT pillar mix (retail earns transactability from a real browser cart but lower access/legibility; the pure API earns zero transactability but full access). Two same-overall members now pin different pillar shapes — the guard spans the low scale by shape, not just the endpoints. api.replicate.com's 18.18 legibility is the LOWEST of the non-anchor set.

sweep_presence_HONEST.consequence: UNLIKE ipinfo.io (already sweep-present x3 at pin time, so its weld was immediately unlockable), api.replicate.com is ABSENT from every committed sweep. So this baseline pin does NOT immediately unlock the 5th-non-anchor cross-path WELD: a future [LOCAL] cadence run must FIRST add api.replicate.com to experiments/calibration_sweep.py's POPULATION and score it (the books.toscrape.com pattern, Local cycle 20260807T051750Z), THEN a peer-gated weld PR can add it to _NON_ANCHOR_WELDED with n_compared>=1.
